diagnosis.runtime: Canonical Step then exposed the real omitted post-checkpoint population-policy update. Initial beat grid 0 differed from the live 25/3 grid. The replayed first step spawned actor 0 one tick too soon. Record normalized policy updates at their committed boundary and replay them in sequence; no validation or world-equality relaxation.

corrections: Explicit selection→Open→Discard in previously automatic portable/paging fixtures.
Final recovery preparation uses actual desktop Step clicks.
Population policy changes are journal records with exact normalized-field validation, cooperative immutable ownership and regression continuation across 1000 ticks.
MIDI clock journey waits for actual WebMIDI note submission before stopping its owner; source frames and strict lateness assertions remain unchanged.
